mechanism: Dexamethasone induces CYP3A4 and other hepatic enzymes, potentially reducing disulfiram metabolism and increasing disulfiram levels; disulfiram may inhibit corticosteroid metabolism via CYP3A4 inhibition, creating bidirectional enzyme interaction.
action: Monitor for enhanced disulfiram adverse effects (hepatotoxicity, neuropathy) and corticosteroid effects; consider alternative corticosteroid or increased disulfiram monitoring; ensure adequate hepatic function assessment.
